Kapil Sibal accuses BJP of horse-trading for parliamentary majority

Senior politician Kapil Sibal has accused the ruling BJP of engaging in "horse-trading" to secure a two-thirds majority in Parliament. This accusation comes ahead of the Monsoon Session, intensifying the political discourse. The claims were reported by centrist Hindi media outlets.
